sections.title: Renewals in the next 60 days
sections.sql: select name,status,renewal_due,unpaid_invoices from member_health where status in ('active','lapsed') and renewal_due<=current_date+60 order by renewal_due

sections.title: Events
sections.sql: select name,starts_on,capacity,booked,waiting from event_summary order by starts_on

sections.title: Arrears
sections.sql: select member,currency,balance,due_on from invoice_balances where not void and balance>0 and due_on<current_date order by due_on

sections.title: Volunteer cover
sections.sql: select name,event,due_on,volunteer,status from duty_roster where status<>'done' order by due_on

sections.title: Committee actions
sections.sql: select name,owner,due_on from committee_actions where status='open' order by due_on

sections.title: Officer evidence
sections.sql: select name,role,ends_on,consent_ref,eligibility_ref from officers order by ends_on

sections.title: Governance dates
sections.sql: select name,jurisdiction,due_on,source_url,completed_on from obligations order by due_on

sections.title: Learning gaps
sections.sql: select name,training_hours,training_target from member_health where status='active' and training_hours<training_target order by name
